claim_disclaimer: NO performance claim; designs/03: a replay-only win is not the 10x application claim.  Warm-up documents the compiler boundary only.

matched_resources.process: single interpreter, single thread of replay
matched_resources.input: C11 medium ring (seed 23, 40 origins, 100 dests, cutoff 8.0), one producer trace consumed by all arms

legacy_python_replay.method: module-global fold replaced by a counting wrapper; the pure-Python loop re-reads the global each origin; figure snapshotted after the FIRST replay only

compiled_driver.evidence: with the trace module's global fold replaced by a poison wrapper, the compiled replay STILL returned the exact bits: the fold is bound inside compiled code; the outer loop makes ONE Python call (the driver) per replay

copies_per_replay.per_origin: 1 fresh C-order distance copy + 1 fresh gathered-weights copy (both arms)
copies_per_replay.note: identical copy composition by construction; the compiled copies happen inside the nogil driver
